claim: We have never used commercially available lab equipment for finger-stick based tests.

res.reason: Sources found conflict with part of this claim, but no clear contrary fact could be stated, so no verdict is given.

claim: Right now, Theranos is only collecting finger-prick blood samples for its herpes test, and that's only being run on the company's own technology.

res.reason: The retrieved Business Insider report of Elizabeth Holmes's 2015 WSJDLive interview contains the quoted statement that Theranos was only collecting finger-prick samples for its herpes test and running it on its own technology, so the quote is accurately attributed to that interview.

res.reason: No clear public record was found for this sentence.

claim: All its tests are therefore LDTs, effectively exempt from FDA oversight.

res.reason: The claim that all LDTs are effectively exempt from FDA oversight is contradicted by the evidence: the FDA is phasing out its enforcement discretion approach for LDTs so that laboratory-manufactured IVDs will generally fall under FDA regulation (FDA LDT FAQs).
